individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot shows n=141 individual sample measurements as distinct markers.
Scatter plot type is exempt; each marker represents one cell line/reporter combination with error bars showing variability.
Continuous density/distribution curves (line plot type) are exempt from requiring individual point overlay.
Box plot (exempt type) additionally overlays individual ridge-length data points as dots on top of the boxes.
Polar histograms display the full distribution of phase-difference values directly, analogous to a density/histogram plot.
Polar histogram showing distribution of subtype-averaged phase differences; histogram format inherently displays the distribution rather than a single summary statistic.
Line/trace plot illustrating a single example fit; line plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Scatter plot shows n=117 individual sample measurements as distinct markers, with error bars reflecting fit uncertainty for each sample.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Scatter plot with marginal histograms shows individual points and fitted gamma distribution curves, no error bars present.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Data represents the mean plus/minus s.d. of 6 samples per reporter (n = 2 biological replicates a technical triplicates or duplicates [HCC1806 Per2-Luc, n = 5]). n = 3 for MCF10A and MDAMB468-Per2-Luc (single experiment).
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars (horizontal and vertical) are present and defined as mean +/- SD in the caption.
Panel shows smooth normal-distribution density curves without error bars.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: the bottom and top edges of the boxes representing the 25th and 75th percentiles, respectively. Extending whiskers represent data points within 1.5 times the interquartile range from lower and upper quartile. Median values are marked by red horizontal lines, and outliers by red crosses.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box plot elements (box edges, whiskers, median line, outliers) are fully defined in the caption.
Polar histogram bars show normalized probability distributions without error bars.
Polar histogram of subtype-averaged phase differences shows no error bars.
Example trace and fitted curve panel, no error bars present.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Error bars represent the standard deviation of the fitted parameters, reflecting their uncertainty as determined by the fitting process.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars are present and explicitly defined in the caption as SD of fitted parameters.
